contract_rule: Each run can further restrict these families and ceilings; strength is a family parameter, not a universal severity measure.

selection.failure_samples: Interpretable SCREENING outcomes of currently VALID original search candidates
selection.unknown_rule: Retained explicitly; excluded from binary failure denominators
selection.filter: Contract-invalid, disallowed and unaffordable proposals before ranking

random_exploration.seed: Recorded run seed + attempt slot ordinal
random_exploration.attempt_rule: Duplicate images and rejected selections consume bounded attempts; they do not invent unique images.

evidence.retention: Immutable per-batch input context, proposed/selected rankings, costs, quotas and revisions; retained response is decoded after recovery without another send.

evaluation_status: Frozen engineering defaults for Phase08 evaluation; no measured probability, optimality or lift claim.
